unit: 100 = a mid 1st in the next rookie draft, the same week; additive (two 50s trade for one 100)
method: LightGBM on H-week log returns of StatHead as-of trade values (no look-ahead): momentum, calendar, age, draft capital and production features; median and 10%/90% quantile models. Checked out of sample (walk-forward by time, and by held-out players) against a no-change baseline. value is the median forecast; lo / hi the 10-90% range.
